title: Anosov Diffeomorphisms of Finite-Type Surfaces
summary: We prove that a complete surface of finite topological type satisfying Condition A is homeomorphic to the two-torus. More generally, we show that an isolated planar end of a complete open surface satisfying Condition A cannot be periodic under the induced action on the space of ends. Condition A includes dense periodic points, a uniformly hyperbolic splitting into one-dimensional subbundles for a complete metric, and invariant line fields that uniquely integrate to transverse stable and unstable foliations.
